"In each recorded cell" for (i)-(vii) is not feasible as one protocol (high-chloride whole-cell, perforated-patch E_GABA, TTX mIPSC, evoked IPSC with PPR cannot all be run in one cell without compromise). Minimum that survives: perforated-patch cohort for native-chloride sIPSC/mIPSC/evoked IPSC plus puffed-agonist reversal; whole-cell cohort with antagonists for event identity; Rs/Cm/Rin per cell; animal as unit; Cre-positive WT, HT, KO analysed separately. The two-lever step stays exploratory.
